prompt: clang init_seg library init_priority value Windows
answer:
On Windows, Clang maps `init_seg` to these initialization priorities:

| `init_seg` | Priority |
|---|---:|
| `compiler` | 200 |
| `library` / `lib` | 400 |
| `user` | 65535 (default) |

A lower value means higher initialization priority. Thus, `compiler` initializes first, followed by `library`, then `user`.
